description: Miracle Claw main window — spawn the launcher sidecar to boot the bundled chat gateway, then host the chat UI at localhost:28789/. The launcher sidecar is the only executable the webview is permitted to invoke; the bundled Node runtime is kept off the permission boundary by being exec'd FROM the launcher rather than directly. Permissions include all 13 custom Tauri commands declared in src-tauri/permissions/ (Lesson 513 rc19).
